name: Amano Hanei
source: Yuu's childhood friend and a witch. In her childhood, she used to fly around with a vacuum cleaner instead of a broom (in the magic world, it's normal to use a vacuum cleaner to fly around). She is also the leader of the group which plays with the children in the park.
